name: Michigan
agency: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS) local office

period.description: Your deductible is a monthly amount; each calendar month is a separate deductible period.

submission.description: Report your medical costs every month by uploading them to your MI Bridges account or returning them to your local MDHHS office.

notes: Paid bills only count for the month you got the care. Unpaid bills can be used for any month.
Your worker uses your oldest unpaid bills first, and each bill can only be used once.
Bills or receipts should show the date of service, the amount owed or paid, and who got the care.
You do not have to pay a bill before you report it.
